I wrote 13 tests in `tests/public/test_bonfire.py`. `sandbox/compile_check.py` reports no errors. All 13 currently fail with a Runtime Error because `src/main.py` raises `not implemented`, as expected.

- **Samples:** the three samples from the statement, one test each.
- **Smallest input:** N=1 with the target cell `(-1,0)` (answer `1`) and with `(1,0)` (answer `0`).
- **The edge the statement singles out:** new smoke is generated only if (0,0) has no smoke. With `NSN`, the smoke returns to (0,0) at t=2, so nothing new is made. Two tests watch this from cells `(1,0)` and `(-1,0)`.
- **Largest size, N=200000:**
  - all `N` moves, watched from R=−N (the most extreme row allowed), where smoke first arrives at t=N
  - all `N` moves, watched from `(-1,0)`, which has smoke at every step
  - all `E` moves, watched from C=N
  - the corner (−N,−N), which no smoke can reach because it is 2N steps away and only N moves happen (all zeros)
  - alternating `NS`, watched from both sides, which gives the repeating patterns `01…` and `10…`

I worked out the answers that the statement doesn't give by hand. Each test has a comment explaining how. As a cross-check, I wrote a separate script that follows the rules step by step and ran it on small versions of every case. It reproduced all three samples and every hand-derived pattern. That script is only in the scratchpad and is not part of the suite.

13 tests, in 1 file.
